item.title: 'Punch in the gut': Homes sales fall to their lowest in 16 years
item.description: Existing homes sales in October declined 8.8% from a year earlier, according to the National Association of Realtors.

item.title: Witnesses describe the D.C. shooting that left 1 dead, 4 injured
item.description: A gunman opened fire at a gym in Washington, D.C.'s Logan Circle Thursday morning. One person has been confirmed killed and four others injured. The gunman is dead, according to police.

item.title: Indonesia's VP resigns as his eligibility and academic credentials are questioned
item.description: Raka is the son of former President Joko Widodo. The Constitutional Court and the Supreme Court ruled last month that the documents that Raka submitted regarding his overseas education didn't meet election requirements.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid alleged spy scandal
item.description: Huang co-founded the chipmaker Nvidia, which has become one of the driving forces behind the AI boom. But reports that he may have had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy quickly sank his career.

item.title: Colom wins Mississippi Senate race. And, White House warns Dems over future probes
item.description: After more than a week of counting ballots, Scott Colom has narrowly won the Mississippi Senate seat. And, the White House has sent a letter warning Democrats who plan to investigate the administration.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Senators don't always share bill text online before votes. They should, advocates say
item.description: The text of what lawmakers are considering isn't always made available for public review before it is voted on. A group of open governance advocates is calling on Senate leadership for a change.
